keyEvents.text: First Half ends, Shakhtar Donetsk 0, Sporting Lisbon 0.
Delay in match because of an injury Silas Andersen (Sporting Lisbon).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Shakhtar Donetsk 0, Sporting Lisbon 1. Issa Doumbia (Sporting Lisbon) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner.
Maxi Araújo (Sporting Lisbon) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Shakhtar Donetsk. Newerton replaces Gleiker Mendoza.
Substitution, Shakhtar Donetsk. Isaque replaces Yehor Nazaryna.
